title: Arabian Tagine with Snow Peas
description: A keto-friendly variation of the classic Moroccan tagine, featuring snow peas and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the tagine and cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the snow peas and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the warm water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the liquid has reduced slightly.
Season with salt and cumin to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional snow peas if desired.
